thesis: Management runs a disciplined, shareholder-friendly playbook: steady dividend growth, refranchised bottling and incentives tied to organic revenue and EPS. Delivery against guidance has been reliable, though insiders have been modest net sellers.

strengths.point: Organic revenue guidance met or beaten in most recent years.
Long-term incentives weight relative TSR and EPS, aligning pay with owners.

risks.point: Executive pay is large relative to peers, which may blunt cost discipline.

conviction_reason: Long, verifiable record of capital returns and guidance delivery.
